target.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages
target.body:
## Summary

- add experimental `claws export <agent-id> --out <new-directory>`
- project one installed agent into the grouped portable Claw schema
- copy ledger-managed workspace files and safe workspace-relative avatars into package sidecars
- preserve recorded package identity only for exact recorded state; synthesize a content-derived development identity after local changes
- normalize empty optional arrays and expand `~` in output paths

## Scope

Export reads the provenance established by the add/status lifecycle and writes a new self-contained package without mutating the installed Claw. It accepts an exact agent id, explicitly projects portable agent fields, copies only ledger-managed workspace files plus a validated local avatar, emits exact recorded package references, and refuses unavailable managed files or an existing output directory.

HTTP/data avatars remain inline. A safe local avatar is read through the pinned workspace avatar boundary, copied under `workspace/`, and rewritten to a workspace-relative manifest path; missing or unsafe local avatars are omitted instead of exported as dangling paths.

An exact complete install with unchanged agent config, managed files, package references, and no unmanaged local avatar preserves its recorded package version (and package name for package-backed installs). Modified or newly captured local state is emitted as `openclaw-claw-<agent-id>@0.0.0-export.<content-hash>` so it cannot claim the original published release identity.

## Stack

- RFC: https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27
- Depends on: #102296 status/remove and ownership-aware lifecycle state
- This PR: portable creation/export experience
- Next: #102383 gateway-owned cron lifecycle

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- focused Oxlint: 0 warnings, 0 errors
- 28 focused export, CLI, and lifecycle E2E tests
- `git diff --check`
- `codex review --base cd8c6f5f66234361bda8209ff228aa4d0a06f7d7`: no actionable regressions

## Real behavior proof

The real CLI E2E passes add -> export -> inspect -> add from the exported package in isolated state. Export writes `package.json`, `openclaw.claw.json`, managed workspace sidecars, and a portable agent manifest; the fresh add recreates the agent from that package.
